source_dataset: Already-inspected corrective-autonomous validation: Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9 two-player, 32 independent maps seed6351000, 154 sampled positions, candidate replies complete
verification: The native selected index maximized the stored searched opponent-reply score in every paired slate. Every frozen-source autonomous reply and root choice was uncensored. The audit only reread existing candidate records and ran no game, training, or new native search.
interpretation: High aggregate pair ranking and 132 exact choices conceal missed consequential native overrides: only 16 of 32 nonstatic teacher indices are reproduced, with strict searched-reply-score regret at 22 positions across 19 independent maps. This sampled diagnostic does not exhibit a seat-one-specific ranking collapse: seat one has 10 regret positions in 75 versus seat zero 12 in 79. Pair comparisons and positions within a map are correlated, and native one-turn reply score is not terminal outcome. These data cannot explain the prior hybrid's seat-one complete-game regression on their own; policy-induced states and persistent strategy remain unmeasured boundaries.
decision: Do not tune, rate, or deploy the failed hybrid or students on these already-used maps. A subsequent experiment must measure candidate ranking on each policy's actual complete-game state distribution with fresh predeclared independent maps and both-seat complete-game and runtime gates before promotion.
